coverage: Actual router responses for /console, /console/app.js and /console/style.css carry required Content-Security-Policy directives.
Policy restricts default/script/style/connect sources to self, blocks framing, base URI and form actions, and excludes unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval.
Public assets carry no stored records or fixture credentials; protected data routes remain authenticated.
limitation: This is a native in-process router regression on Darwin. The Linux workflow separately retained console functional PASS and screenshots, but did not retain an independent raw HTTP CSP header capture.
